## What Does Affordable Plastic Surgery Miami Really Cost?

Cosmetic surgery investments vary widely. National surgeon's fees provide a reliable baseline for planning your budget. According to [ASPS 2023 Average Surgeon Fees](https://www.plasticsurgery.org/documents/news/Statistics/2023/cosmetic-procedures-average-cost-2023.pdf), **breast augmentation** averaged $4,875 for the surgeon's portion alone.

Full costs include anesthesia, facility fees, and implants. In Miami's competitive market, these typically range $6,000 to $12,000 depending on your goals. These estimates reflect local market data, so your consultation will provide an accurate quote.

Here's what common procedures cost at Alluring, aligned with ASPS benchmarks and updated for **plastic surgery costs Miami 2026**:

**Breast Augmentation** runs $6,000-$12,000 total, with surgeon fees around $4,875 per ASPS data. Silicone implants or combined lifts add customization options. [Learn more about breast augmentation](/procedures/breast-augmentation-miami).

**Tummy Tuck (Abdominoplasty)** totals $8,000-$15,000. It's ideal for post-pregnancy bodies or after significant weight loss. ASPS 2024 trends show steady demand for this procedure, up 1% from the previous year.

Looking for comprehensive restoration? A **Mommy Makeover** combines tummy tuck, breast lift or augmentation, and liposuction. Expect $12,000-$25,000 for this value-packed combination. Explore our [mommy makeover options](/procedures/mommy-makeover-miami).

**Brazilian Butt Lift (BBL)** remains popular in Miami. At Alluring a BBL starts at $5,500, and most patients pay between $5,500 and $10,000, including the liposuction that harvests the fat. Every price is personalized. [See BBL pricing](/procedures/brazilian-butt-lift-bbl-miami#pricing).

**Liposuction**: Lipo 360 at Alluring starts at $4,000, and one area added to another procedure is $500 to $1,500, depending on the area. [See Lipo 360 cost in Miami](/procedures/liposuction-miami#pricing).

Miami's vibrant market keeps options competitive. Always prioritize your surgeon's training and safety record over bargain pricing. Individual results vary, and your unique anatomy shapes the final quote during consultation.

## What Factors Shape Your Personalized Investment?

No two transformations are identical. Costs at Alluring Plastic Surgery reflect your specific goals and body type. Procedure complexity tops the list—a standalone **tummy tuck** differs significantly from a full **mommy makeover** combining breast work and liposuction.

What else influences your quote?

**Areas Treated** matter considerably. Multi-zone liposuction or BBL fat transfer increases the scope of your procedure. More areas mean more time in the operating room.

**Technique and Add-Ons** also play a role. Muscle repair in tummy tucks adds complexity. Implant type for breast procedures affects both results and cost.

**Anesthesia and Facility Fees** are part of every surgical quote. Ask what yours includes, so you can compare prices like for like.

**Surgeon Experience** matters as much as price. Dr. Victoria Karlinsky, MD, FACS, performs every procedure at Alluring. She is board certified in general surgery by the American Board of Surgery and is a Fellow of the American College of Surgeons.

Read our guide on [choosing a plastic surgeon](/how-to-choose-the-best-plastic-surgeon-in-miami-10-things-to-look-for) for more guidance. During consultation, we outline your quote transparently with a focus on value.
